# fivenines_node_types (Data Source)

Lists the workflow node catalog, with each node type's JSON Schema and whether it is available to the authenticated organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fivenines_node_types" "all" {}

# The trigger nodes this organization is actually allowed to use
output "available_triggers" {
  value = [
    for nt in data.fivenines_node_types.all.node_types :
    nt.type if nt.category == "trigger" && nt.available
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `node_types` (Attributes List) List of node types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_types))

<a id="nestedatt--node_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_types`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether this node type is available for the organization (based on feature flags).
- `category` (String) Node category (trigger, logic, action, notification).
- `schema_json` (String) JSON Schema describing the node's required and optional data fields, as a JSON string.
- `type` (String) Node type identifier, as used in a workflow execution graph.
